title_en: Kangda Medical and Health Products Company v. Northwest Industrial and Commercial Newspaper and Shaanxi Province Medical Equipment Company — dispute over infringement of legal person's right to reputation
keywords_en: Civil; Dispute over right to reputation; Second instance; Intermediate People's Court; Shaanxi Province; Legal person; General Principles of the Civil Law; Whether false news reports constitute reputation infringement; Whether the party providing materials bears tort liability; Allocation of compensation liability; Partial support; Medical device sales; False news report; Damage to reputation; Economic loss; Tort liability; Right to reputation; Dispute over a company infringing on a legal person's right to reputation
full_text_en:
Kangda Medical and Health Care Products Company v. Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper Office and Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company — Dispute over Infringement of Corporate Reputation Right

Plaintiff: Xi'an Kangda Medical and Health Care Products Company.

Legal Representative: Yan Zhenying, Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Dong Junyan, staff member of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Chen Zhitang, lawyer of Xi'an Lianhu District Law Firm.

Defendant: Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper Office.

Legal Representative: Huang Jicai, Person in Charge of the Newspaper Office.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Lisheng, lawyer of Xi'an First Law Firm.

Defendant: Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company.

Legal Representative: Xu Guo'an, Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Xu Yi, lawyer of Xi'an First Law Firm.

The plaintiff, Xi'an Kangda Medical and Health Care Products Company, filed a lawsuit with the Lianhu District People's Court of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, on the grounds that the defendants, Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper Office and Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company, had infringed upon its corporate reputation right.

The plaintiff alleged: On March 18, 1988, the Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper published a report signed by "Pingfang" in which it openly disseminated that among the medical equipment worth over RMB 2,000,000 sold by the Company to the Staff Hospital of the Northwest Electric Power Administration, some large-scale equipment had quality problems and the prices were higher than the state-set prices. After the report was published, it not only damaged the Company's reputation but also caused economic losses of RMB 300,000 to the Company. The plaintiff requested restoration of reputation and compensation for losses.

The defendant Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper Office argued: The report in the Industry and Commerce Newspaper was directed at problems existing in the entire society and the entire industry, not at a specific unit; the source of the article's materials was provided by Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company, and the newspaper had no intention of infringement. The materials used in the article were not verified; it was willing to restore the plaintiff's reputation through a newspaper publication but disagreed to compensate for losses.

The defendant Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company argued: The materials provided by the Company to the newspaper were based on information reported by others. The Company did not ask the journalist to make a public report. The Company's opinions were also not solicited before the report was published, and therefore it should not bear tort liability.

After accepting the case, the Lianhu District People's Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and, through public trial, found the following facts:

In November 1987, the Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper (hereinafter referred to as the IC Newspaper) sent its journalist Zhao Pingfang to Shaanxi Provincial Medical Equipment Company (hereinafter referred to as the Provincial Medical Equipment Company) for an interview. The manager of that company, Xu Guo'an, informed Zhao Pingfang that the Staff Hospital of the Northwest Electric Power Administration had purchased medical equipment worth over RMB 2,000,000 from Xi'an Kangda Medical and Health Care Products Company (hereinafter referred to as Kangda Company), and among them, many large-scale equipment had quality problems, and Kangda Company also sold products at prices higher than the state-set prices. Based on the above interview, Zhao Pingfang wrote a news article entitled "Management over the Supervision of Medical Equipment Production and Sales Should Be Strengthened", which, after review by the IC Newspaper editorial department, was published in the IC Newspaper on March 18, 1988. After the article was published, Kangda Company reported to the IC Newspaper that the above report was untrue. The IC Newspaper relayed this situation to the Provincial Medical Equipment Company. The Provincial Medical Equipment Company sent a letter to the IC Newspaper editorial department regarding this issue, stating: "The article has received positive feedback after publication. The main points mentioned in the article are all... policies and regulations stipulated by the state. The specific content is also basically factual; as for individual wording discrepancies, they are not substantive issues. We welcome your newspaper to publish more such articles in the future..." Due to the publication of this report in the IC Newspaper, some users no longer placed orders with Kangda Company, and some users terminated their purchase and sales contracts with Kangda Company, causing Kangda Company to suffer certain economic losses.

Additionally, it was found that the large-scale medical equipment purchased by the Staff Hospital of the Northwest Electric Power Administration from the plaintiff had all been inspected and accepted by professional and technical personnel, complied with product quality standards, and no problem of the plaintiff selling products at prices higher than the state-set prices was discovered.

The Lianhu District People's Court held: The plaintiff is an independent legal entity and its operation of medical equipment in accordance with the state-prescribed product quality and product prices is lawful. The defendants, the Provincial Medical Equipment Company and the IC Newspaper, without verifying the information reported by others, even criticized the plaintiff by name in the newspaper for selling products at prices higher than the state-set prices and for many of the large-scale medical equipment sold being of substandard quality. Pursuant to Article 120, paragraphs 1 and 2, of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the acts of the two defendants infringed upon the corporate reputation right. The plaintiff's request for restoration of reputation, elimination of adverse effects, apology, and compensation for losses are reasonable and should be supported. The plaintiff's reputation right was infringed and it suffered economic losses. Pursuant to Article 106, paragraph 1, of the General Principles of the Civil Law, the two defendants shall bear civil liability for the consequences caused by their own fault.

Accordingly, on September 18, 1989, the court rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant Northwest Industry and Commerce Newspaper Office shall publish a notice in the newspaper to restore the plaintiff's reputation, eliminate adverse effects, and make an apology;

2. The defendant Provincial Medical Equipment Company shall compensate the plaintiff for economic losses in the amount of RMB 30,000.

After the judgment was pronounced, the defendant Provincial Medical Equipment Company filed an appeal with the Xi'an Intermediate People's Court on the ground that the original judgment's order of compensation for economic losses by only one party was unfair.

The Xi'an Intermediate People's Court, at second instance, held: The defendant at first instance, the IC Newspaper, without verifying the critical manuscript written by journalist Zhao Pingfang, published a criticism naming the appellee Kangda Company in the newspaper, resulting in the falsity of the report and damaging Kangda Company's reputation. Its act infringed upon Kangda Company's reputation right and shall bear civil liability. The appellant, the Provincial Medical Equipment Company, provided information to the newspaper without verification on the basis of reports from others; especially after the article was published, knowing that Kangda Company had objections, it still sent a letter to the newspaper confirming that the reported information was basically factual, which also constituted a tort. The original judgment ordering only the Provincial Medical Equipment Company to bear compensation liability was inappropriate, and the appellant's grounds of appeal should be adopted. Accordingly, on December 17, 1989, the Xi'an Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. Affirm item 1 of the original judgment;

2. Reverse item 2 of the original judgment;

3. Within one month after this judgment takes effect, the Provincial Medical Equipment Company shall compensate Kangda Company RMB 15,000, and the IC Newspaper Office shall compensate Kangda Company RMB 5,000.
